encoder_localization_diagnostic.interpretation: The earliest observed difference was the first-stage encoder output before posterior sampling. Image inputs, corresponding RNG checkpoints and sampler noise were exact. The observation localizes divergence within or before the observed encoder output, without isolating a kernel or validating full-generation correctness.

encoder_scoped_ab_diagnostic.interpretation: Only the math-only SDPA phase had exact equality for all observed tensors across its two input constructions. Original settings, cuDNN deterministic alone, and the final restored-original control differed. This motivates separate full-runtime qualification; it does not prove universal determinism, identify the originally selected kernel, or repair the failed strict proof.

equivalent_uncached_executions.interpretation: Equivalent uncached normal executions differ before any comparison involving reordering or cache substitution. The hardware or algorithmic cause is not established.

cases.geometry_observation: Both: delivery-truck side panel and lower body stretch and smear as it fills the right side; the rear-wheel region develops overlapping/irregular wheel shapes in frame 16, a detached wheel-like fragment at frame 20, and the remaining visible wheel is pinched/fragmented at frame 24. This is materially more than changing viewpoint alone.

Both: the white delivery van in the far intersection starts as a coherent box vehicle at frames 1/6, then its cargo silhouette, cab/wheels, and side markings deform into irregular pale masses by frames 12/18/20/24. Adjacent pale crossing cars also become stretched and ghosted. Foreground cars, lane geometry, buildings, and signals remain comparatively stable.

No major silhouette or road-geometry failure seen. Some small text/plate and background detail are soft or change slightly, but vehicle bodies and lane boundaries stay coherent at the inspected native frames.

Sedan, mixer drum/chassis, lane lines, and major architecture remain coherent. Small distant moving objects are soft, but no conspicuous new break or major deformation is visible in the inspected native frames.

Substantial shared deformation. In frames 16 and 18 the close truck wheel and wheel arch bulge and split into poorly connected contours; by 21 and 24 the lower edge and tire contact region become flattened or ragged. The truck side lettering and reflections also stretch. This goes beyond merely changing perspective.

Shared conspicuous shape/texture drift in the crossing white delivery vehicle: the clear tall box and side logo in frames 1 and 6 become a softened, irregular van-like silhouette by frames 12, 18 and 20, with weakened/merged contours and unstable marking layout at frame 24. Nearby crossing vehicles also blur together. Foreground cars, poles and lane layout remain largely stable.

Main vehicle silhouettes, lane markings and traffic-light poles stay coherent. There is small soft-texture/marking drift in distant traffic and reflections, but no clear major structural collapse in inspected native frames.
Sedan, mixer drum, truck wheel arrangement and building layout stay coherent. Small texture/edge changes appear, but no major shape collapse is visible in the inspected native samples.
